text:
tess: FYI noticed p99 jump only for client=ios on /v1/chat at 11:42. p50/p95 flat. dashboard shows p99 up to ~2.3s for that minute.

omar: I pulled traces. minute bucket has n=12 for ios. web n=400. looks like a tiny-sample tail.

lucy: Are we showing counts anywhere in the latency card? I had to click through to traces to see n. should surface n near each percentile.

tess: we currently render percentiles from tdigest rollups. at small n tdigest merge noise can exaggerate p99.

omar: quick query I ran: SELECT minute, caller, percentile(99,latency_ms) AS p99, count(*) AS n FROM traces WHERE endpoint='/v1/chat' AND minute='2026-01-18T11:42:00Z' GROUP BY minute, caller; result: ios p99=2290 n=12, web p99=210 n=412.

lucy: Proposal: 1) show "(n=...)" next to each percentile in the card tooltip; 2) if n<50 show a yellow "low-sample" pill and offer an "exact" button that hits /raw-agg for that minute.

omar: Backend already has /raw-agg but add perf guard. Also record telemetry when users request exact to see load.

tess: Also overlay rollout weight history on the same sparkline. minute-aligned weights would quickly show if a fallback happened.

lucy: For alerts: annotate alert payload with samplecount and add a flag if n<30 so oncall knows to treat p99 as suspect.

omar: I'll prototype the badge + exact toggle this week. lucy can you update the alert rule change? tess can we run tdigest vs raw sims to pick a default cutoff?

tess: yes I'll run sims and post a small table: expected error vs n for p95/p99 with current compression=200.

devops-bot: ticket created: CON-2001 "Latency UI: inline samplecount, low-sample advisory, exact-agg toggle, weight overlay" assigned to eng-platform.

lucy: thanks. action items: omar frontend prototype, tess sims, lucy alert tweak. we'll demo at next sync.

omar: quick note: also ensure retries are broken out per-sample so retry-heavy minutes are obvious.

tess: good point. include retry_fraction in the badge: e.g. "p99 2290ms (n=12, r=4) [33mlow samples[0m"

lucy: closing for now — reopen if exact agg shows a real backend issue.
